label: Level
description: country, province, district or chiefdom. Table 2 heads its four regions "Province"; Table 3 lists units under each district in the place its title calls "chiefdom", including four cities (Kenema City, Koidu/New, Makeni City, Bo City) and the areas of the Western Area (Koya, Mountain, Waterloo, York Rural; Central 1 to West 3)

label: Province
description: The province a district or chiefdom lies in, as Table 2 writes it (Eastern, Northern, Southern, Western); empty for the country and the provinces

label: District
description: The 2015 district a chiefdom lies in, as Table 2 writes it (Table 3 writes the districts in capitals, and Bo as BO-SOUTH); empty above the chiefdoms

label: Men
description: Male population (total population: household and institutional), census reference night of 4 to 5 December 2015

label: Women
description: Female population (total population: household and institutional), census reference night of 4 to 5 December 2015

label: Total
description: Total population, both sexes, census reference night of 4 to 5 December 2015

label: Table
description: The table of the Summary of Final Results the row was read from: Table 2 (country, provinces, districts) or Table 3 (chiefdoms)

label: Printed page
description: The page number printed in the volume. Each table runs across a two-page spread; the page given is the left-hand one, which holds the columns read (total, male, female)
